title: Shoppers disbelief as bears found wondering around Thatcham car park x
summary: Shoppers were in a state of shock when two brown bears wandered through the car park next to Waitrose in Thatcham. Luckily the bears were just looking for food and not interested in attacking anyone. By the time the police arrived, some hours later, the bear had gone.
imageAlt: Two bears on the road next to Waitrose
caption: Two bears on the road next to Waitrose

content.text:
Shoppers were surprised and slightly frightened when they saw a bear in the car park next to waitrose in Thatcham. The incident happened at around 4 pm on Saturday afternoon as shoppers were getting their groceries ready for the evening.

One shopper, Tracy Smith, said: "I'd parked around the corner from the car park and I heard lots of shouting and screaming. The next thing I knew I saw two bears walking up the road towards me so I got in the car and shut the doors quick the bears didn't seem to pay any attention to me at all. I think they were just going for a stroll. I had no idea that there were any bears at all in West Berkshire."
